field.title: Screen a patient
field.consentNotice: Your eye photo will be checked by a computer and, if needed, by an eye specialist. It is used only for your screening.
field.consentGiven: The patient has heard this notice and agrees

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.unavailable: The grading service is not available right now. The image has not been graded.

refer.title: REFER
refer.next: See an eye doctor within 4 weeks.

routine.title: ROUTINE
routine.next: No referral needed today. Come back for your next scheduled screening.

retake.title: RETAKE
retake.next: Follow the instruction below and take the image again.

defocus.hold_steady: The image is blurred. Hold the camera steady and refocus before capturing.

underexposed.nasal: The nose side of this image is too dark. Move the light slightly to the right.

partial_fov.centre: Part of the retina is cut off. Centre the eye in the circle and capture again.

overexposed.reduce_light: The image is too bright. Reduce the light and capture again.

media_opacity.dilate: The view is hazy. Dilate the pupil if permitted and capture again.

retake.escalate: Cannot screen here — refer for a dilated exam.

l2.haemorrhages_multi_quadrant: Haemorrhages in more than one quadrant (ICDR level 2)

l3.haemorrhages_four_quadrants: Haemorrhages in all four quadrants (ICDR level 3)

l4.nv_proxy: Possible new vessel growth — vessel-shape proxy, not a confirmed detection (ICDR level 4)

review.title: Review
review.empty: No case yet. Screen an image first.

found.heading: What we found
found.refer: We found signs of damage in the small blood vessels of your eye.
found.routine: We did not find signs of diabetic eye damage today.
found.retake: The photo of your eye was not clear enough. It needs to be taken again.

next.heading: What happens next
next.refer: See an eye doctor within 4 weeks. Treatment keeps your sight.
next.routine: Keep your diabetes under control and come back for your next screening.
next.retake: The health worker will take another photo now.

where.heading: Where to go
where.pending: Your health worker will give you the place and time.
